h: Analyst says Governor Makinde's 2027 presidential bid is a test of the waters, not a serious bid to win
p: A political analyst has reportedly described Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde's move towards the 2027 presidential race as exploratory. The analyst said it appears aimed at gauging support rather than a determined push to win. Makinde's camp has not been quoted in the report.
more: The 2027 field is already crowded, with APC, ADC and NDC camps all making their pitch.
Analysts say the North-West and South-West could decide the race.
